data.logicContent:
SELECT
    o.${s_topic_field} as uid,
    o.${s_mdl_dte_field} as sample_mdl_dte,
    o.uid,
    o.mdl_dte,
    o.m6_up_flg_btch_cnt_rat,
    o.m6_up_flg_btch_cnt,
    o.m6_up_flg_all_cnt_rat,
    o.m6_up_flg_all_cnt,
    o.lag_his_rep_amt_sum_per_mth_btch_rat_mor_50_per_cnt,
    o.lag_his_rep_amt_sum_per_mth_btch_rat_max,
    o.lag_his_rep_amt_sum_per_mth_btch_rat_avg,
    o.lag_his_rep_amt_sum_per_mth_all_rat_mor_50_per_cnt,
    o.lag_his_rep_amt_sum_per_mth_all_rat_max,
    o.lag_his_rep_amt_sum_per_mth_all_rat_avg,
    o.ds,
    o.d90_his_rep_amt_sum_btch,
    o.d90_his_rep_amt_sum_all,
    o.d90_d360_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_btch,
    o.d90_d360_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_all,
    o.d90_d180_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_btch,
    o.d90_d180_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_all,
    o.d60_his_rep_amt_sum_btch,
    o.d60_his_rep_amt_sum_all,
    o.d360_his_rep_amt_sum_btch,
    o.d360_his_rep_amt_sum_all,
    o.d30_his_rep_amt_sum_btch,
    o.d30_his_rep_amt_sum_all,
    o.d30_d90_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_btch,
    o.d30_d90_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_all,
    o.d30_d60_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_btch,
    o.d30_d60_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_all,
    o.d30_d180_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_btch,
    o.d30_d180_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_all,
    o.d180_his_rep_amt_sum_btch,
    o.d180_his_rep_amt_sum_all,
    o.d180_d360_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_btch,
    o.d180_d360_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_all
FROM (
        SELECT
            s.${s_topic_field},
            s.${s_mdl_dte_field},
            f.uid,
            f.mdl_dte,
            f.m6_up_flg_btch_cnt_rat,
            f.m6_up_flg_btch_cnt,
            f.m6_up_flg_all_cnt_rat,
            f.m6_up_flg_all_cnt,
            f.lag_his_rep_amt_sum_per_mth_btch_rat_mor_50_per_cnt,
            f.lag_his_rep_amt_sum_per_mth_btch_rat_max,
            f.lag_his_rep_amt_sum_per_mth_btch_rat_avg,
            f.lag_his_rep_amt_sum_per_mth_all_rat_mor_50_per_cnt,
            f.lag_his_rep_amt_sum_per_mth_all_rat_max,
            f.lag_his_rep_amt_sum_per_mth_all_rat_avg,
            f.ds,
            f.d90_his_rep_amt_sum_btch,
            f.d90_his_rep_amt_sum_all,
            f.d90_d360_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_btch,
            f.d90_d360_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_all,
            f.d90_d180_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_btch,
            f.d90_d180_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_all,
            f.d60_his_rep_amt_sum_btch,
            f.d60_his_rep_amt_sum_all,
            f.d360_his_rep_amt_sum_btch,
            f.d360_his_rep_amt_sum_all,
            f.d30_his_rep_amt_sum_btch,
            f.d30_his_rep_amt_sum_all,
            f.d30_d90_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_btch,
            f.d30_d90_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_all,
            f.d30_d60_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_btch,
            f.d30_d60_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_all,
            f.d30_d180_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_btch,
            f.d30_d180_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_all,
            f.d180_his_rep_amt_sum_btch,
            f.d180_his_rep_amt_sum_all,
            f.d180_d360_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_btch,
            f.d180_d360_his_rep_amt_sum_rat_all,
            row_number() over(partition by s.${s_topic_field} order by f.ds desc) as rn
        FROM ${sample_table} s
        LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT
                        *
                    FROM
                        dwa_risk.dwa_risk_dz_model_12his_rep_pressure_trend_df
                    WHERE
                        to_date(to_date(ds,'yyyyMMdd')) >= ${min_ds}
                    AND
                        ds <= ${max_ds}
                    ) f
        ON
            s.${s_topic_field} = f.uid
        AND
            datediff(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) = 0
    ) o  WHERE rn=1;
